name: all1page
description: All1page — tek pencerede birden çok site; her panel kendi oturumuyla (Electron).
author: Omer

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build && cross-env ALL1PAGE_CHROME_PROFILE=1 electron .
scripts.dev:chrome: concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 ALL1PAGE_CHROME_PROFILE=1 electron ."
scripts.clean: if exist release rd /s /q release && mkdir release
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run prep:lang && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean && npm run prep:lang && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:portable: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:publish: npm run clean && npm run prep:lang && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis -p always && node scripts/publish.js
